parsed.review_summary: The edited rationale corrects all four error targets identified in the original. It properly acknowledges the concrete details already present in the comment (location, quoted passage, specific concepts needing clarification), removes the unsupported requirement that the comment must specify a particular form (equations/derivations/formal definition), corrects the factual error about authors lacking guidance, and avoids stating a numeric score or gold label while accurately describing rubric-relevant qualities (explicit action + concrete implementation details). Unrelated reasoning is preserved, and no new evidence is invented. The rationale can serve as a coherent ground for rescoring.
